diagnostics: Initial headless launch exited before asynchronous completion. An ephemeral loopback debugger listener keeps this Chromium version alive; the carrier does not use its protocol.
First Office carrier runs timed out at loading-workers because nested pthread script responses lacked COEP. Responses now carry the required isolation headers.

A diagnostic trace.push override made the otherwise successful worker result uncloneable. The probe now observes without adding a function property to the result array. Unhandled worker promise rejections also cross the carrier immediately.
One diagnostic no-sandbox run did not fix that uncloneable result. That flag was removed; the qualified runs retain Chromium's default sandbox.

The isolated x86 runtime has no pytest installation. Its attempted pytest command failed before collection; the subsequent real x86 Python conversion qualifies only the recorded driver path, not an x86 pytest suite.
